input.subject: Nami
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Weather science and Clima-Tact, heat/cool manipulation, lightning and Mirage Tempo; Wano Zeus resides in the Clima-Tact after his previous cloud body is taken. Preserve a weather controller with real projectile/status or companion mechanics, not generic lightning reskin. Verify Zeus chronology. No pre-destruction standalone Zeus body claimed as current. Weather-created slowing must be disclosed as game abstraction; no arbitrary regeneration negation. Navigation and money-minded personality do not automatically imply attack-speed/healing magic.

context.cutoff: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
context.coverage: Character-specific capabilities are requirements to verify, not evidence. Record unsupported facts as gaps. No old generated artifacts supplied.

research.subject: Nami
gaps: The supplied pages do not provide the requested game's current contract, supported schema details beyond the output schema, legal path structure, purchase costs, unlock schedules, projectile-flight rules, target geometry, status definitions, or shared-technique lifecycle. A playable implementation cannot be verified against those rules from the supplied evidence.

Any numerical tuning, damage values, ranges, cooldowns, resource costs, status durations, companion behavior, and purchase sequencing would be game adaptations rather than canon facts and require separate disclosure and balancing evidence.

The pages support weather manipulation, lightning, heat, mirages, wind, cloud creation, and Zeus's sentient Clima-Tact integration, but do not establish arbitrary regeneration negation, generic slowing as a canon effect, shields, taunt, healing, or attack-speed magic.

The requested cutoff excludes material after Wano. Source 9523e2588612aa9f0bd5b51f contains later Egghead and Elbaf claims, including attacks against S-Snake, Saturn, and Road; those claims were not used.

The supplied evidence does not establish a complete list of every Nami technique or every limitation through the end of Wano, so unsupported requested features should remain omitted rather than inferred.
